skills.name: trackiq-amazon-amc-media-mix
skills.title: TrackIQ: Amazon AMC Media Mix
skills.summary: A twelve-slide Amazon Marketing Cloud deck arguing one case — where the budget goes versus where new customers come from. Attribution paths, what DSP is worth alone versus in a path, cost per new customer by channel, time to purchase, and one reallocation with the arithmetic shown.

delivery.note: in-chat always works and is the fallback. file needs a filesystem, n8n needs network, slack and email need their tool connected. Outward sends confirm first.

skills.fallback: Works from exported AMC attribution-path, NTB-by-campaign and time-to-conversion tables plus monthly spend by channel. Slides 3-10 build from pasted figures; slide 11 records which pulls were manual.

skills.name: trackiq-amazon-budget-pacing
skills.title: TrackIQ: Amazon Budget Pacing and Month-End Forecast
skills.summary: Builds a mid-month Amazon advertising pacing report — month-to-date spend against the plan, a day-weighted projection to month end, the gap in dollars, which portfolios are capping out before the day is over, which are underdelivering their share, and a reallocation table that moves budget from the second to the first.

delivery.note: in-chat always works and is the fallback. Outward sends confirm first.

skills.name: trackiq-amazon-dsp-performance
skills.title: TrackIQ: Amazon DSP Audience and Creative Performance
skills.summary: Breaks Amazon DSP down by audience, creative, inventory source, technology and geography to show which segments actually recruit customers and which burn impressions. Ranks on new-to-brand purchases, detail page views and cost per action rather than ROAS, because DSP revenue is not returned at these dimensions.

delivery.note: in-chat always works and is the fallback. Outward sends confirm first.

skills.name: trackiq-amazon-search-term-harvester
skills.title: TrackIQ: Amazon Search-Term Harvester
skills.summary: Finds the Amazon search terms that already convert above break-even but have no keyword of their own, and turns them into an upload-ready Sponsored Products bulk file with exact-match keywords and suggested bids. Checks every candidate against the existing targets so nothing is proposed twice.

delivery.note: in-chat always works and is the fallback. Outward sends confirm first.

skills.name: trackiq-amazon-wasted-spend
skills.title: TrackIQ: Amazon Wasted-Spend Sweeper
skills.summary: Finds Amazon advertising spend that is not paying for itself — keywords that spent and sold nothing, keywords bidding above what they return, the same keyword duplicated across ad groups bidding against itself, and search terms worth negating — then produces an Amazon bulk-operations workbook with the campaign, ad group and keyword IDs already attached, plus a one-page summary of what is being cut and why.

delivery.note: in-chat always works and is the fallback. Outward sends confirm first.

skills.name: trackiq-amazon-category-priority-keywords
skills.title: TrackIQ: Amazon Category Priority Keywords
skills.summary: Groups an Amazon catalogue into product categories, then picks the 25 search terms per category worth tracking organic rank on — each with weekly volume, estimated monthly revenue, impression share, and whether the rank tracker already covers it.

delivery.note: in-chat always works and is the fallback. file needs a filesystem, n8n needs network, slack and email need their tool connected. Outward sends confirm first.

skills.fallback: Works from a Brand Analytics Search Query Performance export plus revenue and orders by ASIN when the TrackIQ MCP is not connected. Everything except the rank-tracker column is reproducible.

skills.name: trackiq-amazon-rank-movement
skills.title: TrackIQ: Amazon Organic Rank Movement Tracker
skills.summary: Tracks weekly organic rank movement across a brand's priority keyword set by sampling live search results, compares it to the previous run, and weights every gain and loss by what that keyword is worth in revenue so the drops that cost real money surface first and the rest stay quiet.

requires.third_party_note: Requires an Oxylabs scraper connection; the public page is the only source for this data.

delivery.note: in-chat always works and is the fallback. Outward sends confirm first.

skills.name: trackiq-amazon-rank-readiness
skills.title: TrackIQ: Amazon Rank Readiness
skills.summary: Decides which search terms deserve advertising spend or seeding on a single ASIN, by testing whether a bought organic rank would survive the money stopping — your conversion rate against the market's on the same query. Returns FUND, SEED, TEST or NO-GO per keyword plus a designed HTML report.

delivery.note: in-chat always works and is the fallback. file needs a filesystem, n8n needs network, slack and email need their tool connected. Outward sends confirm first.

skills.fallback: The bundled scripts only do arithmetic and layout. Without Python, assets/method.md carries every threshold and assets/pulling-data.md the exact pulls, so the same verdicts can be produced by hand as a table.

skills.name: trackiq-amazon-search-visibility-audit
skills.title: TrackIQ: Amazon Search Visibility Audit
skills.summary: Audits where an Amazon brand's ASINs actually appear in search — organic rank per revenue-bearing query, the terms bought but not ranked, the terms ranked and still paid for, share of voice, and the revenue sitting behind the queries the brand is absent from.

delivery.note: in-chat always works and is the fallback. file needs a filesystem, n8n needs network, slack and email need their tool connected. Outward sends confirm first.

skills.fallback: Works from a rank-tracker export, a Search Query Performance export and a search-term report plus revenue by ASIN. Every section except share-of-voice movement is reproducible that way.

skills.name: trackiq-amazon-share-of-shelf
skills.title: TrackIQ: Amazon Share of Shelf
skills.summary: Measures how much of Amazon page one a brand owns for the keywords that carry its revenue — organic slots, sponsored slots and Amazon's Choice badges per keyword, rolled up by category, against the competitor brands holding the rest, with week-over-week movement and the revenue behind every keyword the brand is absent from.

requires.third_party_note: Requires an Oxylabs scraper connection for live Amazon search results: 1 credit per keyword per run, plus a one-off 1 credit per ASIN for brand resolution. There is no first-party substitute — without it the report cannot be produced.

delivery.note: in-chat always works and is the fallback. file needs a filesystem, n8n needs network, slack and email need their tool connected. Outward sends confirm first.

skills.fallback: None for the shelf itself. Live search results cannot be substituted from first-party data, and the skill says so rather than approximating page one from rank tracking.

skills.name: trackiq-amazon-catalog-hygiene
skills.title: TrackIQ: Amazon Catalog and Variation Hygiene Audit
skills.summary: Sweeps a whole Amazon catalogue for the quiet defects nobody owns — thin image sets, truncating or short titles, bullet counts above or below what displays, orphaned and duplicate SKUs, dead and GUID listings cluttering the inventory, products with no ads and no traffic, and listings that are live but not buyable — ranked by revenue at risk so the list is finite.

requires.third_party_note: Requires an Oxylabs scraper connection; the public page is the only source for this data.

delivery.note: in-chat always works and is the fallback. Outward sends confirm first.

skills.name: trackiq-amazon-competitor-teardown
skills.title: TrackIQ: Amazon Competitor Listing Teardown
skills.summary: Puts one Amazon product page side by side with the three or four beating it on the shelf — title structure, image count, bullet construction, price and price per unit, coupons, rating and review depth, and rank — then says what to change and in what order. Compares content, not slots.

requires.third_party_note: Requires an Oxylabs scraper connection; the public page is the only source for this data.

delivery.note: in-chat always works and is the fallback. Outward sends confirm first.

skills.name: trackiq-amazon-listing-monitor
skills.title: TrackIQ: Amazon Listing Monitor
skills.summary: Watches a brand's listings daily and alerts only when something actually moved — a rewritten title or bullet, a lost image, a missing A+ description, a category move, a new seller in the buy box, price or rating past a threshold, or a listing that has stopped being purchasable. Each finding carries the revenue behind that ASIN. Silence is the normal output.

requires.third_party_note: Requires an Oxylabs scraper connection for listing state: 1 credit per watched ASIN per run. Listing state has to be observed from the public page — first-party data will not show a title rewrite. Also needs somewhere to keep dated snapshots between runs; without yesterday's snapshot there is nothing to diff.

delivery.note: Silence is the normal output — only sends when something moved. in-chat always works and is the fallback. Outward sends confirm first.

skills.fallback: None. Without the scraper it cannot observe listing state, and without stored snapshots it can take a baseline and nothing more. The skill says so rather than pretending to monitor.

skills.name: trackiq-amazon-listing-optimizer
skills.title: TrackIQ: Amazon Listing Optimizer
skills.summary: Rewrites one Amazon listing — title, bullets, description and backend terms — against the terms it should rank for and the questions shoppers actually ask, producing a side-by-side of current and proposed copy with the reason for every change. Built for how Amazon matches intent and answers questions in 2026, not for keyword stuffing.

requires.third_party_note: Requires an Oxylabs scraper connection; the public page is the only source for this data.

delivery.note: in-chat always works and is the fallback. Outward sends confirm first.

skills.name: trackiq-amazon-review-miner
skills.title: TrackIQ: Amazon Review and Voice-of-Customer Miner
skills.summary: Builds a voice-of-customer picture for a brand by sampling reviews across its own catalogue and its competitors, clustering what buyers praise and complain about into themes, and turning those into bullet and A+ copy directions plus negative keywords. Uses the full star distribution for anything quantitative because only about eight review bodies are retrievable per product.

requires.third_party_note: Requires an Oxylabs scraper connection; the public page is the only source for this data.

delivery.note: in-chat always works and is the fallback. Outward sends confirm first.

skills.name: trackiq-amazon-demand-forecast
skills.title: TrackIQ: Amazon Demand Forecast and Reorder Plan
skills.summary: Turns trailing sales and last year's seasonal shape into a week-by-week demand forecast per Amazon product, then converts it into order quantities and order-by dates that account for lead time, safety stock and the service level the brand wants — with the forecast error stated so nobody treats it as certain.

delivery.note: in-chat always works and is the fallback. Outward sends confirm first.

skills.name: trackiq-amazon-excess-inventory
skills.title: TrackIQ: Amazon Excess and Aged Inventory Plan
skills.summary: Finds the Amazon inventory sitting too long — products with cover far beyond target, stock stranded on SKUs that no longer sell, and unfulfillable units — and ranks them by capital tied up, with a recommendation per product to discount, advertise, bundle, remove or write off.

delivery.note: in-chat always works and is the fallback. Outward sends confirm first.

skills.name: trackiq-amazon-inventory-ad-throttle
skills.title: TrackIQ: Amazon Inventory Risk → Ad Spend Throttle
skills.summary: Finds the Amazon campaigns still paying to advertise products that are about to run out of stock, and produces an upload-ready bulk file that throttles or pauses those ads with the real campaign, ad group and ad IDs attached — plus where the freed budget should go instead.

delivery.note: in-chat always works and is the fallback. Outward sends confirm first.

skills.name: trackiq-amazon-restock-priority
skills.title: TrackIQ: Amazon Restock Priority
skills.summary: Works out which Amazon products to ship next and in what order — days of cover at the current sales rate, the date each one runs out, the date a purchase order needed placing to beat it, the revenue exposed if it is late, and a starting shipment quantity per product. Ranked by revenue at risk rather than by days of cover.

delivery.note: in-chat always works and is the fallback. Outward sends confirm first.

skills.name: trackiq-amazon-stockout-impact
skills.title: TrackIQ: Amazon Stockout Impact and Recovery
skills.summary: Measures what a completed Amazon stockout actually cost — lost units and revenue against the pre-stockout run rate, how far sessions and conversion fell, whether they have come back, and how long recovery is taking — then produces a staged plan for restarting ads and rebuilding rank.

requires.third_party_note: Requires an Oxylabs scraper connection; the public page is the only source for this data.

delivery.note: in-chat always works and is the fallback. Outward sends confirm first.

skills.name: trackiq-amazon-daily-snacks-email
skills.title: TrackIQ: Amazon Daily Snacks Email
skills.summary: A three-minute editorial daily email for an Amazon account — one lead story with a takeaway, quick bites, a scoreboard, charts and a to-do list.
skills.changelog: Replaces the bundled sample data with a fictional demo brand shared with the weekly report.
skills.fallback: Works from figures pasted into the chat when the TrackIQ MCP is not connected.

delivery.note: in-chat always works and is the fallback. file needs a filesystem, n8n needs network, slack and email need their tool connected. Outward sends confirm first.

skills.name: trackiq-amazon-launch-scorecard
skills.title: TrackIQ: Amazon Launch Scorecard
skills.summary: Grades a newly launched Amazon ASIN week by week through its first twelve weeks — units and revenue against a target curve, session growth, conversion rate, review accumulation, organic rank on its target keywords, and TACoS against a declining break-even glide path — ending in a go, hold or fix verdict with one lever.

requires.third_party_note: Requires an Oxylabs scraper connection; the public page is the only source for this data.

delivery.note: in-chat always works and is the fallback. Outward sends confirm first.

skills.name: trackiq-amazon-monthly-business-review
skills.title: TrackIQ: Amazon Monthly Business Review
skills.summary: Builds the month-end client deck for one Amazon brand — revenue and spend against the previous month and the same month last year, the organic and paid split, category and product mix, what moved and why, and a prioritised plan for next month. Checks that last year's ad data actually exists before drawing a year-on-year comparison.

delivery.note: in-chat always works and is the fallback. Outward sends confirm first.

skills.name: trackiq-amazon-sales-movers
skills.title: TrackIQ: Amazon Sales Movers and Root Cause
skills.summary: Ranks an Amazon catalogue by how much each product's revenue moved between two periods and decomposes every mover into its cause — traffic, conversion rate, units per order, or average selling price — so the answer is "sessions fell 31%", not "sales are down".

delivery.note: in-chat always works and is the fallback. Outward sends confirm first.

skills.name: trackiq-amazon-weekly-executive-report
skills.title: TrackIQ: Amazon Weekly Executive Report
skills.summary: A client-ready week-over-week Amazon recap — scorecard, pacing against the brand's own trailing four-week average, per-line marginal return, DSP breakout, keyword economics, inventory days-of-cover and this week's decisions.
skills.fallback: Works from this week's and last week's figures pasted into the chat when the TrackIQ MCP is not connected.

delivery.note: in-chat always works and is the fallback. file needs a filesystem, n8n needs network, slack and email need their tool connected. Outward sends confirm first.
